structural_breaks.note: FY2021 AR restates FY2020 营业收入 44,095.32 → 44,598.31 (+502.99m, +1.1%; 调整后/调整前 columns, reason not stated on the summary page). FY2021 in-year quarters unaffected (table = quarterly reports).

新疆众和 (XJZH; high-purity aluminium, electronic foil, alloys) consolidated as a same-control merger (合并日 2022-12-23). FY2021 restated 61,278.37 → 68,967.68 (+7,689.31m, +12.5%); the FY2022 quarterly table is restated (Q1 17,100.16 → 19,149.13; H1 38,720.20 → 42,585.82; 9M 64,542.46 → 69,902.45). FY2022 quarters have no same-scope printed comparative → YoY vs FY2021 points is inflated ≈12%.

新疆特变电工自控设备有限公司 (自控公司) consolidated as same-control merger; FY2022 restated 95,886.75 → 96,393.96 (+507.21m); FY2023 quarterly table restated in-year (Q1 26,273.71 → 26,487.18; H1 49,778.08 → 50,074.71; 9M 73,594.73 → 73,891.36). Transformer-product FY2022 restated in the FY2023 AR note (13,528.06 → 13,962.34) and 2023H1 restated in the 2024 H1 report (7,783.71 → 8,058.63).
Product row renamed 变压器产品 → 电气设备产品 from the FY2024 AR; growth rates printed against the old 变压器产品 figures (FY2023 18,484.73; 2024H1 10,308.61) show the same base.
Same-control mergers: 防城港公司 67% (Jan 2025, via XJZH), 修试公司 100% (Apr 2025, via 衡变公司), 广西宏创再生资源 100% (Dec 2025); FY2024 restated 97,778.22 → 97,821.95 (+43.73m, immaterial).

profile.products: Per FY2025 AR p.12-16: (1) 输变电 — UHV DC converter transformers & smoothing reactors, AC power transformers & reactors, special (chemical/smelting/traction) transformers, dry-type transformers, box substations, distribution transformers, bushings, CT/VT, secondary systems, HV switchgear/GIS/GIL, MV/LV switchgear, capacitors, wires & cables ≤750kV, international T&D EPC; (2) 新能源 — high-purity polysilicon (新特能源), PV inverters, storage, SVG, VSC-HVDC valves, wind/PV EPC & IPP; (3) 能源 — coal mining (天池能源), power & heat; (4) 新材料 — high-purity aluminium, electronic foil, electrode foil, alloys (XJZH). FY2025 main-business revenue by product (万元): 电气设备 2,675,964.82; 煤炭 1,696,566.08; 电线电缆 1,556,891.04; 新能源产品及工程 1,355,535.61; 发电 718,333.35; 铝电子新材料 630,253.40; 输变电成套工程 492,490.96.

collection_notes: Sources: TBEA periodic reports from cninfo static PDFs (2015 AR 修订版). Values FY2015–FY2025 = AR 分季度主要财务数据 3-month figures (FY2018 table read with pdfplumber: vertical label layout). FY2026Q1 = Q1 report; FY2026Q2 = H1 56,554.75 − Q1 24,946.05.
Checks: Σ quarters = FY 营业收入 every year; Q1/H1/9M/Q3 = quarterly reports except documented restatement years (2022, 2023).
TBEA consolidates a finance company (特变电工集团财务有限公司): 营业总收入 > 营业收入; 营业收入 is used throughout.

Because polysilicon/coal dominate consolidated revenue, revenue_segment (transformer/electrical-equipment products, H) and orders_segment are the relevant series for transformer-peer analysis; they are semi-annual only (no quarterly product disclosure).
